name: Lesotho
famous_for: 'Kingdom in the Sky' (only country entirely above 1,000m), Maletsunyane single-drop falls, and Basotho wool blankets.
tourists: Over 1.1M visitors; famous for Semonkong abseiling at Maletsunyane Falls, Sani Pass 4x4 trails, and Afriski slopes.
must_know: The Basotho woolen blanket (Kobo) and woven conical hat (Mokorotlo) are proud national garments worn in daily mountain life.
fun_fact: Lesotho has the highest lowest-point of any sovereign country in the world, with its lowest point sitting at 1,400 meters altitude.
